description: This file defines the `WheelDistribution` class, which represents a wheel distribution in a Python packaging context. It includes methods to retrieve metadata from wheel files and prepares distribution metadata, integrating with pip internals.

classes.name: WheelDistribution
classes.description: Represents a wheel distribution, providing methods to access wheel metadata and interact with pip's distribution system.

methods.name: Optional[str] build_tracker_id(self)
methods.description: Returns None, indicating no build tracker ID is used for wheel distributions.

methods.name: BaseDistribution get_metadata_distribution(self)
methods.description: Loads and returns the metadata of the wheel file as a BaseDistribution object by reading the wheel file directly.

methods.name: None prepare_distribution_metadata( self, finder: PackageFinder, build_isolation: bool, check_build_deps: bool, )
methods.description: Prepares distribution metadata using a PackageFinder, with options for build isolation and dependency checks. Currently, this method is a placeholder with no implementation.
